name: Spare the Dying

targets.description: A creature with 0 Hit Points that isn't dead.

cantrip_scaling.text: Range doubles: 30 feet at character level 5, 60 feet at level 11, 120 feet at level 17.

summary: A creature at 0 Hit Points within range becomes Stable; the range doubles at levels 5, 11 and 17.
text: Choose a creature within range that has 0 Hit Points and isn't dead; it becomes Stable. The range doubles to 30 feet at character level 5, 60 feet at level 11 and 120 feet at level 17.
